@section l35-09 | Unit 9 | Vocabulary practice · Unit 9 | 文意字彙・選擇題・配合題
@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Winning a scholarship to Harvard University is a great h______r. You should be very proud of yourself.
= honor
~詞義 honor（n.）榮譽;光榮
~原文 Winning a scholarship to Harvard University is a great honor. You should be very proud of yourself.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The old lady t______ted her ankle while walking on the uneven sidewalk.
= twisted
~詞義 twist（v.）扭到
~原文 The old lady twisted her ankle while walking on the uneven sidewalk.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The s______w that the father felt over his daughter's death was too much for him to bear.
= sorrow
~詞義 sorrow（n.）悲傷
~原文 The sorrow that the father felt over his daughter's death was too much for him to bear.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: In Taiwan, there are two major ______ (politics) parties. One is the Democratic Progressive Party, and the other is the Kuomintang.
= political
~詞義 political（adj.）政治的
~原文 In Taiwan, there are two major political parties. One is the Democratic Progressive Party, and the other is the Kuomintang.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It's important to wear sunglasses as ______ (protect) for your eyes when the sun is very bright.
= protection
~詞義 protection（n.）保護
~原文 It's important to wear sunglasses as protection for your eyes when the sun is very bright.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Justin likes to do ______ activities such as skiing, mountain climbing, and hiking.
A: honest
B: plastic
C: sincere
D: outdoor
= D
~詞義 outdoor（adj.）戶外的
~原文 Justin likes to do outdoor activities such as skiing, mountain climbing, and hiking.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Checking the map, the general realized that his troops were only five ______ from their enemy.
A: politicians
B: dealers
C: kilometers
D: tourists
= C
~詞義 kilometer（n.）公里
~原文 Checking the map, the general realized that his troops were only five kilometers from their enemy.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The doctor told Wendy not to worry about the big ______ on her arm—it was only a bruise.
A: bump
B: thread
C: liver
D: twin
= A
~詞義 bump（n.）腫塊
~原文 The doctor told Wendy not to worry about the big bump on her arm—it was only a bruise.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Though Joanna was born in Taipei, she considers Taichung her ______. She has worked there for decades.
A: plastic
B: tourism
C: sincerity
D: hometown
= D
~詞義 hometown（n.）家鄉
~原文 Though Joanna was born in Taipei, she considers Taichung her hometown. She has worked there for decades.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The scientist found a small ______ of salt in the water sample taken from the river.
A: rumor
B: trace
C: ton
D: deal
= B
~詞義 trace（n.）微量
~原文 The scientist found a small trace of salt in the water sample taken from the river.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: indoors
B: dealer
C: nap
D: fireworks
E: tourist
F: lung

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: It's raining cats and dogs! Let's go ______ and play chess.
= A
~詞義 indoors（adv.）往室內
~原文 It's raining cats and dogs! Let's go indoors and play chess.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Everyone knows there is a strong relationship between smoking and ______ cancer.
= F
~詞義 lung（n.）肺臟
~原文 Everyone knows there is a strong relationship between smoking and lung cancer.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: At the New Year's Eve countdown party, people can view a(n) ______ display.
= D
~詞義 fireworks（n.）煙火
~原文 At the New Year's Eve countdown party, people can view a(n) fireworks display.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Sun Moon Lake is one of Taiwan's most popular ______ attractions.
= E
~詞義 tourist（adj.）觀光(景點)
~原文 Sun Moon Lake is one of Taiwan's most popular tourist attractions.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: My sister wanted to sell her old car, so she found a car ______ to arrange the sale for her.
= B
~詞義 dealer（n.）商人
~原文 My sister wanted to sell her old car, so she found a car dealer to arrange the sale for her.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: column
B: plastic
C: pilot
D: clue
E: protective
F: stuff

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Wearing sunglasses provides people's eyes with a ______ layer against bright light from the sun.
= E
~詞義 protective（adj.）保護的
~原文 Wearing sunglasses provides people's eyes with a protective layer against bright light from the sun.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Charles is trying to ______ his bag with snacks and drinks before leaving for school.
= F
~詞義 stuff（v.）塞滿
~原文 Charles is trying to stuff his bag with snacks and drinks before leaving for school.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: According to the investigation, the air crash was caused by ______ error.
= C
~詞義 pilot（n.）飛行員
~原文 According to the investigation, the air crash was caused by pilot error.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: My classmates didn't have a ______ as to what the lecturer was talking about.
= D
~詞義 clue（n.）線索
~原文 My classmates didn't have a clue as to what the lecturer was talking about.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: It is better to store food in glass containers than ______ ones.
= B
~詞義 plastic（adj.）塑膠的
~原文 It is better to store food in glass containers than plastic ones.
